title: A small world. A big responsibility.
text: Far from Earth, a small world is counting on you. Welcome to Mission Dhruva. An adventure where curiosity keeps a Mars outpost alive.

title: Learning happens through doing.
text: This is more than a journey through screens. You are the scientist. Explore four connected systems. Make predictions, run experiments, and discover why every decision matters.

title: Every watt has somewhere to be.
text: Start with a fixed supply of energy. Give more power to the greenhouse, and another system must receive less. Test your plan. The choices you make here will shape the storm ahead.

title: Grow a little tomorrow.
text: Choose a crop. Study its needs. With six units of water and three growing cycles, experiment with what helps it thrive. More water cannot replace missing light. Every harvest tells a story.

title: Think it through. Then act.
text: When the storm arrives, there is no countdown. Read the situation. Compare the consequences. Protect your crew, your harvest, or the research. Your preparation changes the outcome.

title: Created by Anthahkarana
text: The mission ends with understanding. Reflect on your decisions, then bring the same scientific thinking back to your garden, your classroom, and your world. Mission Dhruva. Created by Anthahkarana.
